source: Owner message on 2026-11-03 to the Claude session doing the UDA and Mission Control work.
owner_statement: and make sure any prompt which is part of multiple turns will give me a one line GH handoff at the end

earlier_statements.text: continue and give me at the end of every turn a one-line github handoff in case chat is overflowed. make that a rule in UDA also
earlier_statements.where: the requirement record of UDA pull request 440, which this change supersedes

earlier_statements.text: not quoted here; the coverage review note of patterns/owner-requested-terminal-github-handoff.md records it as the activation for that pattern's first version

problem: The pattern's first version activated only when the owner asked in that workstream, and its index trigger said so. Lanes that loaded UDA therefore waited for a new request, and replies in at least one lane kept ending without the line after the owner had asked twice.
required_behavior: For this owner, every final answer in work that spans more than one turn ends with exactly one GH handoff line as its last nonblank line, without a new request.

The line links the exact checkpoint saved and read back in that turn, in the authorized public or private repository, and names the one next action; or it says truthfully that nothing could be saved and why.
A local resume line that a workstream also requires comes before it; the GH handoff line stays last.
A self-contained one-turn answer needs no line unless the owner asks.
basis: patterns/owner-requested-terminal-github-handoff.md before this change, whose activation was per request.
scope: The activation and authority section, rule 2, the distinctness note and the limits of patterns/owner-requested-terminal-github-handoff.md; its LESSON-INDEX.md entry and coverage activation; this record; its tests.

origin.owner_outcome: Every reply in his multi-turn work ends with one line that lets him resume the work from GitHub.
origin.notes: What counts as work that spans more than one turn, and the order after a local resume line, are the assistant's specification of the owner's words.

execution_surfaces.surface: The UDA and Mission Control workstream
execution_surfaces.note: Its turn-end step publishes the handoff note to the owner's private repository, reads it back, and prints the line for the final answer.

execution_surfaces.reason: Each session applies the rule at its next final answer after loading LESSON-INDEX.md, as root AGENTS.md requires before any task.

nonclaims: No repository rule can force a session that never loaded UDA.
A static test proves the rule's text and routing, not that every final answer carries the line; that stays a per-turn check (WORKFLOW_ONLY).
